title: Huge!
text: Huge!. My adult son just graduated from college and lives in our basement. He's a big guy and has been using a beach towel to dry off after his showers. I asked him why he kept taking my nice beach towel and he said it was because his bath towels were big enough to wrap around his body. I had been missing my beach towel when I went out to our hot tub, so I had to reclaim it. But I couldn't do so without replacing it for him. This sheet size bath towel is huge! It fits around his body without any problems. It's pretty thick and plush, but could be both thicker and plusher. I washed it before giving it to him and it got lint on all the rest of the towels, but I'm hoping it got most of it and won't be a problem moving forward. So far, he likes his new towel and I have my beach towel back!
